[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=82.0.1", "wheel>=0.47.0"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "workflows"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Reusable GitHub Actions workflows and automation infrastructure"
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
license = "MIT"
authors = [
    {name = "Workflow Contributors"}
]
keywords = ["github-actions", "workflows", "ci-cd", "automation"]
classifiers = [
    "Development Status :: 3 - Alpha",
    "Intended Audience :: Developers",
    "Topic :: Software Development :: Build Tools",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.12",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.13",
]

[project.urls]
Repository = "https://github.com/stranske/Workflows"
Issues = "https://github.com/stranske/Workflows/issues"

[project.optional-dependencies]
app = []
dev = [
    "pre-commit==4.6.1",
    "black==26.10.1",
    "ruff==0.17.0",
    "isort==9.0.2",
    "docformatter==1.7.8",
    "mypy==2.4.0",
    "flake8==7.3.0",
    "pytest==9.1.1",
    "pytest-cov==7.1.0",
    "coverage==7.16.2",
    "pytest-xdist==3.8.0",
    "httpx==0.28.1",  # Native SDK MockTransport regression tests.
    "packaging>=26.1",

    # Required by repo dependency checks / CI fallback checks
    "hypothesis>=6.155.2",
    "pandas",
    "numpy<3.0",
    "pydantic>=2.13.4",
    "requests>=2.34.0",
    "jsonschema>=4.26.0",
    "rfc3339-validator>=0.1.4",
    "rfc3986-validator>=0.1.1",
    "PyYAML>=6.0.0",

    # Used by scripts/sync_test_dependencies.py to edit pyproject.toml
    "tomlkit>=0.13.0",
    "referencing",
]

# LangChain integration for LLM-enhanced task analysis
# Install with: pip install -e ".[langchain]"
# Versions auto-updated by scripts/update_langchain_versions.py
langchain = [
    "langchain>=1.3.4,<1.4",
    "langchain-core>=1.5.1,<1.6",
    "langchain-community>=0.4.2,<0.5",
    "langchain-openai>=1.4.1,<1.5",
    "langchain-anthropic>=1.5.2,<1.6",
    "faiss-cpu>=1.14.2,<2.0",  # Vector store for dedup workflow
]

[tool.setuptools]
# This repo is primarily automation + scripts; avoid setuptools trying to auto-discover
# random top-level dirs as importable packages (which breaks editable installs).
packages = []

[tool.black]
line-length = 100
target-version = ["py312", "py313"]
include = '\.pyi?$'
extend-exclude = '''
/(
  # Exclude standard directories
  \.eggs
  | \.git
  | \.hg
  | \.mypy_cache
  | \.tox
  | \.venv
  | _build
  | buck-out
  | build
  | dist
  | archive
  | \.extraction
)/
'''

[tool.isort]
profile = "black"
line_length = 100
known_first_party = []
known_third_party = ["scripts", "tools"]
skip_glob = ["archive/*", ".extraction/*"]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
target-version = "py312"
exclude = []

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = [
    "E",  # pycodestyle errors
    "W",  # pycodestyle warnings
    "F",  # pyflakes
    "I",  # isort
    "B",  # flake8-bugbear
    "C4",  # flake8-comprehensions
    "UP",  # pyupgrade - modern Python syntax
    "SIM", # flake8-simplify - code simplification
]
ignore = [
    "E501",  # Line too long (handled by black)
]

[tool.ruff.lint.isort]
# Treat scripts.* and tools.* as third-party so import ordering matches consumer
# repos. Consumer repos have src = ["src", "tests"] which excludes scripts/ and
# tools/ from first-party detection. Without this, our repo treats these as
# first-party (blank line between pydantic and scripts/tools imports) while
# consumers treat them as third-party (no blank line), causing I001 failures
# in synced files.
known-third-party = ["scripts", "tools"]

[tool.flake8]
max-line-length = 100
extend-ignore = ["E501", "W503"]
exclude = [
    ".git",
    "__pycache__",
    ".venv",
    "venv",
    "archive",
    ".extraction",
    "build",
    "dist",
]

[tool.mypy]
python_version = "3.12"
warn_return_any = true
warn_unused_configs = true
disallow_untyped_defs = true
files = ["src"]
disable_error_code = "import-untyped"
exclude = [
    "^archive/",
    "^\\.extraction/",
    "^templates/",
]

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module = ["tests.*"]
ignore_errors = true

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module = ["scripts.*", "tools.*"]
follow_imports = "skip"
ignore_errors = true

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
minversion = "7.0"
testpaths = ["tests", ".github/scripts/__tests__"]
python_files = ["test_*.py", "*_test.py"]
python_classes = ["Test*"]
python_functions = ["test_*"]
addopts = [
    "-ra",
    "--strict-markers",
    "--strict-config",
]
markers = [
    "integration: marks tests as integration tests (may require external resources)",
    "cosmetic: marks tests for cosmetic/formatting changes",
    "slow: marks tests as slow (deselect with '-m \"not slow\"')",
    "serial: marks tests that must run serially",
    "xdist_group: marks tests that must share a single xdist worker",
]
filterwarnings = [
    "error",
]

[tool.coverage.run]
branch = true
parallel = true
source = ["scripts", "tools", "src"]
omit = [
    "*/tests/*",
    "*/test_*.py",
    "*/.venv/*",
    "archive/*",
    ".extraction/*",
    # CI autofix test fixtures - not production code
    "src/trend_analysis/*",
]

[tool.coverage.report]
precision = 2
show_missing = true
skip_covered = false

pyproject.content:
[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=82.0.1", "wheel>=0.47.0"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "workflows"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Reusable GitHub Actions workflows and automation infrastructure"
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.13"
# The standalone CI growth reader imports this outside development extras.
dependencies = ["defusedxml==0.7.1"]
license = "MIT"
authors = [
    {name = "Workflow Contributors"}
]
keywords = ["github-actions", "workflows", "ci-cd", "automation"]
classifiers = [
    "Development Status :: 3 - Alpha",
    "Intended Audience :: Developers",
    "Topic :: Software Development :: Build Tools",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.13",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.14",
]

[project.urls]
Repository = "https://github.com/stranske/Workflows"
Issues = "https://github.com/stranske/Workflows/issues"

[project.optional-dependencies]
app = []
dev = [
    "pre-commit==4.6.1",
    "black==26.10.1",
    "ruff==0.17.3",
    "isort==9.0.2",
    "docformatter==1.7.8",
    "mypy==2.4.1",
    "flake8==7.3.0",
    "pytest==9.2.0",
    "anyio>=4.15.1",  # pytest 9.2 plugin startup with warnings treated as errors.
    "pytest-cov==7.1.0",
    "coverage==7.17.2",
    "pytest-xdist==3.8.0",
    "httpx==0.28.1",  # Native SDK MockTransport regression tests.
    "openai==2.48.0",  # Direct native SDK imports in inert Verify transport tests.
    "anthropic==0.120.0",
    "packaging>=26.1",

    # Required by repo dependency checks / CI fallback checks
    "hypothesis>=6.155.2",
    "pandas",
    "numpy<3.0",
    "pydantic>=2.13.4",
    "requests>=2.34.0",
    "jsonschema>=4.26.0",
    "rfc3339-validator>=0.1.4",
    "rfc3986-validator>=0.1.1",
    "PyYAML>=6.0.0",

    # Used by scripts/sync_test_dependencies.py to edit pyproject.toml
    "tomlkit>=0.13.0",
    "referencing",
]

# LangChain integration for LLM-enhanced task analysis
# Install with: pip install -e ".[langchain]"
# Versions auto-updated by scripts/update_langchain_versions.py
langchain = [
    "langchain>=1.3.4,<1.4",
    "langchain-core>=1.5.1,<1.6",
    "langchain-community>=0.4.2,<0.5",
    "langchain-openai>=1.4.1,<1.5",
    "langchain-anthropic>=1.5.2,<1.6",
    "faiss-cpu>=1.14.2,<2.0",  # Vector store for dedup workflow
]

[tool.setuptools]
# This repo is primarily automation + scripts; avoid setuptools trying to auto-discover
# random top-level dirs as importable packages (which breaks editable installs).
packages = []

[tool.black]
line-length = 100
target-version = ["py313"]
include = '\.pyi?$'
# Frozen public evidence is immutable data, including under explicit-file autofix.
force-exclude = '^/config/verify_paired/representative-v1/'
extend-exclude = '''
/(
  # Exclude standard directories
  \.eggs
  | \.git
  | \.hg
  | \.mypy_cache
  | \.tox
  | \.venv
  | _build
  | buck-out
  | build
  | dist
  | archive
  | \.extraction
)/
'''

[tool.isort]
profile = "black"
line_length = 100
known_first_party = []
known_third_party = ["scripts", "tools"]
skip_glob = ["archive/*", ".extraction/*"]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
target-version = "py313"
# Immutable hash-bound evidence is data, never imported or executed by the runner.
exclude = ["config/verify_paired/representative-v1"]
force-exclude = true

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = [
    "E",  # pycodestyle errors
    "W",  # pycodestyle warnings
    "F",  # pyflakes
    "I",  # isort
    "B",  # flake8-bugbear
    "C4",  # flake8-comprehensions
    "UP",  # pyupgrade - modern Python syntax
    "SIM", # flake8-simplify - code simplification
]
ignore = [
    "E501",  # Line too long (handled by black)
]

[tool.ruff.lint.isort]
# Treat scripts.* and tools.* as third-party so import ordering matches consumer
# repos. Consumer repos have src = ["src", "tests"] which excludes scripts/ and
# tools/ from first-party detection. Without this, our repo treats these as
# first-party (blank line between pydantic and scripts/tools imports) while
# consumers treat them as third-party (no blank line), causing I001 failures
# in synced files.
known-third-party = ["scripts", "tools"]

[tool.flake8]
max-line-length = 100
extend-ignore = ["E501", "W503"]
exclude = [
    ".git",
    "__pycache__",
    ".venv",
    "venv",
    "archive",
    ".extraction",
    "build",
    "dist",
]

[tool.mypy]
python_version = "3.13"
warn_return_any = true
warn_unused_configs = true
disallow_untyped_defs = true
files = ["src"]
disable_error_code = "import-untyped"
exclude = [
    "^archive/",
    "^\\.extraction/",
    "^templates/",
]

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module = ["tests.*"]
ignore_errors = true

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module = ["scripts.*", "tools.*"]
follow_imports = "skip"
ignore_errors = true

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
minversion = "7.0"
testpaths = ["tests", ".github/scripts/__tests__"]
python_files = ["test_*.py", "*_test.py"]
python_classes = ["Test*"]
python_functions = ["test_*"]
addopts = [
    "-ra",
    "--strict-markers",
    "--strict-config",
]
markers = [
    "integration: marks tests as integration tests (may require external resources)",
    "cosmetic: marks tests for cosmetic/formatting changes",
    "slow: marks tests as slow (deselect with '-m \"not slow\"')",
    "quarantine: tests isolated from the canonical suite by explicit maintenance policy",
    "serial: marks tests that must run serially",
    "xdist_group: marks tests that must share a single xdist worker",
]
filterwarnings = [
    "error",
    # LangSmith still calls asyncio.iscoroutinefunction while its pytest plugin
    # loads. Python 3.14 deprecates that helper, which aborts the unmodified
    # `python3 -m pytest -q tests/` gate before collection. Other warnings stay errors.
    "ignore:.*asyncio.iscoroutinefunction.*:DeprecationWarning",
]

[tool.coverage.run]
branch = true
parallel = true
source = ["scripts", "tools", "src"]
omit = [
    "*/tests/*",
    "*/test_*.py",
    "*/.venv/*",
    "archive/*",
    ".extraction/*",
    # CI autofix test fixtures - not production code
    "src/trend_analysis/*",
]

[tool.coverage.report]
precision = 2
show_missing = true
skip_covered = false
# Owner decision 2026-10-16: the `if __name__ == "__main__":` guard only calls
# main(), so it is not measured. Tests of main() itself still count.
# `exclude_also` ADDS to coverage's default exclusions, so every existing
# `# pragma: no cover` keeps working. Do not switch this to `exclude_lines`:
# that REPLACES the defaults and would silently un-exclude every pragma.
exclude_also = [
    "if __name__ == .__main__.:",
]
